anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, 15 minutes), indicating potential over-utilization or a bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows no active trades and zero total profit/loss, which could indicate inactivity or issues with strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review AI system configurations and logs to ensure it is correctly set up to generate learning cycles and identify trading opportunities.
Evaluate the performance and parameters of active trading strategies to ensure they are aligned with current market conditions.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU usage to identify and address any processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to degraded system performance and potential downtime, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform diagnostics on the AI system to determine why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
